import java.util.*;

public class MinCostFlow {
    static final int MAXN = 5500;
    static final long INF = 1000000007L;

    static int n, m, k, c, d;
    static int start, end_node, total_flow = 0, source = MAXN - 2, sink = MAXN - 1, flow_count = 0, parent[] = new int[MAXN];
    static long total_cost = 0, dist[] = new long[MAXN];
    static List<Edge>[] adj = new ArrayList[MAXN];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static class Edge {
        int v, c, idx, cap;

        Edge(int v, int c, int idx, int cap) {
            this.v = v;
            this.c = c;
            this.idx = idx;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cst, int cap) {
        int szU = adj[u].size();
        int szV = adj[v].size();
        adj[u].add(new Edge(v, cst, szV, cap));
        adj[v].add(new Edge(u, -cst, szU, 0));
    }

    static void shortestPath() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, 0, MAXN, INF);
        PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
        dist[source] = 0;
        pq.offer(new long[]{0, source});
        while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
            long[] top = pq.poll();
            long d = top[0];
            int u = (int) top[1];
            if (d > dist[u]) continue;
            for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                if (e.cap > 0 && dist[e.v] > d + e.c) {
                    parent[e.v] = e.idx;
                    dist[e.v] = d + e.c;
                    pq.offer(new long[]{dist[e.v], e.v});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void updateFlow() {
        int flowAdd = k, v = end_node;
        while (v != source) {
            int u = adj[v].get(parent[v]).v;
            int ind = adj[v].get(parent[v]).idx;
            flowAdd = Math.min(flowAdd, adj[u].get(ind).cap);
            v = u;
        }
        total_flow += flowAdd;
        total_cost += (long) flowAdd * dist[end_node];
        v = end_node;
        while (v != source) {
            int u = adj[v].get(parent[v]).v;
            int ind = adj[v].get(parent[v]).idx;
            adj[v].get(parent[v]).cap += flowAdd;
            adj[u].get(ind).cap -= flowAdd;
            v = u;
        }
    }

    static int nodeId(int u, int t) {
        return u + t * n;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        c = sc.nextInt();
        d = sc.nextInt();

        start = n + k;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int u = sc.nextInt();
            addEdge(source, nodeId(u, 0), 0, 1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + k; i++) {
            addEdge(nodeId(1, i), sink, c * i, k);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n + k; j++) {
                addEdge(nodeId(i, j), nodeId(i, j + 1), 0, k);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int u = sc.nextInt();
            int v = sc.nextInt();
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                for (int l = 0; l < n + k; l++) {
                    addEdge(nodeId(u, l), nodeId(v, l + 1), d * (2 * j + 1), 1);
                    addEdge(nodeId(v, l), nodeId(u, l + 1), d * (2 * j + 1), 1);
                }
            }
        }
        while (total_flow < k) {
            shortestPath();
            updateFlow();
        }
        System.out.println(total_cost);
        sc.close();
    }
}
